validation: saved grid and entropy unchanged; deterministic encoder; PCA roundtrip; projection difference equals delta; PCA magnitude <= latent magnitude; unit directions checked
caveats: This is an anchored encoder-projected GRN expression response, not a time derivative, trajectory, entropy gradient, or mechanistic velocity. No recursive GRN propagation. Magnitude is not normalized to one; only display arrow direction is normalized. Anchored post-KO latent is a displacement proxy and need not decode to exact IKZF2 zero. GRN source-amplitude scaling and expression clipping are assumptions inherited from section 11-1. Treg-calibrated GRN and points outside the cell hull require extrapolation; hull is only 2D.
